provenance.description: Authored hosting incident for development. All identifiers, customer statements, and log entries are fictional; this is not a reproduced fault or a real customer ticket.

incident.title: Website returns forbidden after publishing a release
incident.description: The home page says Forbidden after we published a new release at about 10:00 UTC. The hosting panel is still accessible. We did not intentionally change access permissions and do not know what the deployment changed.

context.reported_change: Customer reports publishing a release shortly before the failure; not independently verified.
context.reported_impact: Public home page and stylesheet requests fail.
